description_en: Queries whether a Key Management Service (KMS) key is authorized for a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询KMS密钥是否已授权给MongoDB实例
kebab_example: aliyun dds check-cloud-resource-authorized --db-instance-id dds-bp18f7d6b6a70000 --target-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckCloudResourceAuthorized

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属地域，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html查询
parameters.name: target_region_id

AuthorizationState.description_en:
The authorization status. Valid values:
0: Not authorized.
1: Authorized.
2: The user has not enabled KMS
AuthorizationState.description_zh:
授权状态，取值说明：
0：未授权。
1：已授权。
2：用户未开启KMS

RoleArn.description_en:
The information about the role that is authorized to access Alibaba Cloud resources.
The response includes this parameter only when the return value of AuthorizationState is 1
RoleArn.description_zh:
已授权阿里云资源的角色信息。
当AuthorizationState返回值为1时，才会返回本参数
